name: PM SVANidhi (Street Vendor Loan)
summary: ₹10,000-₹50,000 loan for street vendors without collateral
hindi_summary: Rehri-patri waalon ko bina guarantee ke 10 se 50 hazaar tak ka loan
benefits: ₹10,000 first loan, ₹20,000 second, ₹50,000 third, 7% interest subsidy, digital payments cashback
eligibility: Street vendors with vending certificate or letter of recommendation
